hooks.command: base=""; for r in "$(git symbolic-ref -q --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null)" origin/main origin/master; do [ -n "$r" ] || continue; base=$(git merge-base HEAD "$r" 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$base" ] && break; done; if [ -n "$base" ]; then writ audit --hook claude-code --diff "$base"; else writ audit --hook claude-code; fi
